name: Lead form displays rate limit message when submission quota is exceeded
description: A visitor filling out the client inquiry form receives normal submission confirmation, but when the connection limit is reached, the form displays the rate-limit message advising them to call directly.

planSteps.description: Fill in the name field with Jane Smith.
Fill in the phone field with 555-0123.
Fill in the email field with jane@example.test.
Fill in the message field with Need emergency roof repair.
Verify the status message displays Thank you. We will be in touch shortly.
Click the Trigger Rate Limit button.
Fill in the name field with Jane Smith.
Fill in the phone field with 555-0123.
Fill in the email field with jane@example.test.
Fill in the message field with Second inquiry.
Verify the status message displays Too many requests from your connection. Please try again later or call the business directly.
